fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline

fields.name: HackTool - Hydra Password Bruteforce Execution
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and ((tgt.process.cmdline contains "-u " and tgt.process.cmdline contains "-p ") and (tgt.process.cmdline contains "^USER^" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "^PASS^")))
